notes: BMS paid $286M to 2seventy bio to acquire all remaining oncology rights to Abecma — autologous anti-BCMA CAR-T for relapsed/refractory multiple myeloma. Originally a bluebird bio / Celgene co-development; 2seventy was spun out from bluebird in 2021 and retained 50% economic interest. BMS already commercialized; the 2024 deal cleaned up the partnership economics. Phase-of-deal is 'approved' (Abecma FDA approval Mar 2021). $286M is a smaller deal because it bought only a partial stake; the implied total Abecma asset value is closer to ~$2B based on the percentage transferred. Use $286M as the deal value to be honest about the transaction; this acts as a low-end calibration point on cohort range.
selection_rationale: Third cell-therapy data point with very different size from Kite and Juno. Provides the cohort with range (rather than three clustered $9-12B deals) and represents a BCMA target (vs CD19 for Kite/Juno). Partial-stake nature is a real wrinkle but documented.
source: BMS Q1 2024 disclosure; 2seventy bio Form 10-K Mar 2024; bluebird bio / 2seventy spin-off documents Nov 2021.
